description.narrative: The proposed investment program will improve power supply in provincial urban centers through replacement of high-cost diesel power generation with sustainable renewable energy power generation. The investment program will include (i) construction of about six run-of-river hydropower plants to supply provincial centers, (ii) construction of transmission systems to connect provincial centers, and (iii) capacity building within the power utility and communities. Project preparatory technical assistance (TA) was used in project preparation.

description.narrative: Improved utilization of reliable, clean power to six provincial urban centers

Avoid production of an additional 100,000 tons of CO2 equivalent per annum by the end of 2019. Progress/Status: To be assessed after project completion. Data Source: PPL fuel consumption records. Actual value:

Installation of 5.3 MW of additional hydropower capacity in target provincial areas by the end of 2019. Progress/Status: 1.Divune Hydropower 3MW commenced in August 2016. Overall civil works completed with commissioning to be completed 15 May 2021. 2. Ruu Creek Hydropower Rehabilitation (800kW) project commenced in June 2018. The project was completed and commissioned on October 2019. Certificate of Operation (COA) was issued on 8 November 2019. 3. Lake Hargy Hydropower Rehabilitation (1.5MW) project commenced in May 2018. The project was completed and commissioned on 7 December 2019. Certificate of Operation (COA) was issued on 10 December 2019. Data Source: As-built drawings. Actual value:

Reduce fuel costs for PPL power generation by 60% in target provincial areas by the end of 2019. Progress/Status: To be assessed after project completion. Data Source: PPL financial reports. Actual value:
Reduce power outages by 20% in target provincial urban areas by the end of 2019. Progress/Status: To be assessed after project completion. Data Source: PPL monitoring database. Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Three renewable energy power plants put into operation by PPL. Indicator: Generation of 60 GWh per annum of renewable energy by the end of 2019. Progress/Status: 1. Divune Hydropower 3MW commenced in August 2016. Overall civil works completed with commissioning to be completed 15 May 2021. 2. Ruu Creek Hydropower Rehabilitation (800kW) project commenced in June 2018. The project was completed and commissioned on October 2019. Certificate of Operation (COA) was issued on 8 November 2019. 3. Lake Hargy Hydropower Rehabilitation (1.5MW) project commenced in May 2018. The project was completed and commissioned on 7 December 2019. Certificate of Operation (COA) was issued on 10 December 2019. Data Source: PPL operational records Actual value:

Output: Transmission lines constructed and operated by PPL. Indicator: Transmission of 60 GWh of power per annum to provincial areas by end 2019. Progress/Status: Kimbe-Bialla Transmission line contract is completed with certificate of completion issued and the commissioning was done in December 2017. Data Source: PPL operational records. Actual value:

Output: The PMU renders efficient project management services. Indicator: PMU meets annual target contract awards and disbursements. Progress/Status: PMU has awarded 6 contracts (Design Supervision Consultancy, Divune Ramazon Transmission line Equipment, Kimbe Bialla T/L , Divune Hydro Power Plant, Ru Creek Hydropower Rehabilitation and Lake Hargy Hydropower Rehabilitation. All 5 contracts completed with Disbursements completed except for ongoing contract Divune HPP contract and disbursements is ongoing. Data Source: PPL customer database Facility administration manual Actual value:

Output: Capacity building undertaken for implementing agency and project beneficiaries. Indicator: Conduct capacity building training for PPL in procurement and financial management by June 2019. Progress/Status: A Procurement session on ADB's procurement guidelines was conducted for PPL and the Design Supervision Consultant on 29 May 2013. Two other procurement trainings were also conducted for PPL staff in 2016 and 2017. Capacity Development Training was conducted in October 2016. ADB Safeguards training conducted for PPL staff in 2016. A financial Management training was conducted in December 2019. Data Source: As built drawings PPL GIS database PPLO customer database Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2019 Target value: Y

Output: Capacity building undertaken for implementing agency and project beneficiaries. Indicator: Conduct training for villages adjacent to project sites, including maintenance skills for power and water supply (at least four volunteers per village, including at least 50% women). Progress/Status: Youths from the project site went through practical studies through the apprenticeship course for skilled operators and certified electricians to manange the hydro site facilities and power supply. Out of the 14 youths who sat for the entry test, seven ( one female and six male ) passed and were selected to go through the apprerentice course. The selected youths are currently going through their training with PPL training colleague.
The water maintenance training for water tanks was conducted in February 2020. The training was carried out at Waju village to the water tank committee and 1 female lliving near the water tank to assist the committee leaders. . Data Source: Reports from PPL. Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2019 Target value: Y

Output: Capacity building undertaken for implementing agency and project beneficiaries. Indicator: Conduct training for villages adjacent to project sites, including power safety, household utility budget, and business skills training for each village at the project sites (at least 50% participation women). Progress/Status: 1. Power safety awareness was conducted for Divune, Kimbe-Bialla and Ramazon communities who will be connected to the Divune and Ramazon Hydro power transmission line. Divune 2120 participants (994 female), Kimbe-Bialla 544 participants (151 female), Ramazon 400 participants (170 female).
2. A financial literacy training was also conducted for these communities which included budgeting and savings.
3. Live Safely with Electricity Awareness was conducted for villages along the completed Kimbe-Bialla Transmission Line in Q3 2018. 130 people participated and 62 were female. Data Source: Reports from PPL. Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2019 Target value: Y

Output: The PMU renders efficient project management services. Indicator: Conduct training activities for PMU staff and PPL management including gender awareness training Progress/Status: A National Community Development & Gender officer was recruited to implement the GAP. PMU staff & PPL gender awareness training is part of the GAP. The Natioanl Gender Officer is implementing the GAP and has included the gender awareness training for the PMU & PPL staff in the activity plan. Data Source: Reports from PPL Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2019 Target value: Y

Output: Three renewable energy power plants put into operation by PPL. Indicator: Provide power and water connection to villges adjacent to power generation project site (Divune Hydropower). Progress/Status: Six water tanks were distributed to the Divune HPP Project affected community in Q4 2019. The community were given Community Based Contracts (CBCs) to build and install the water tanks. The water tanks have been installed by end of December 2019. A water committee was set up and there are four (4) female representatives in the committee. Data Source: PPL operational records Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2016 Target value: Y
